description: Create a brand or stage a local token intake draft. Use it when adding a brand; use brand_read for templates, validation, derivation and draft review, or brand_apply to edit a brand. Returns a staged draft or created brand with build results. apply needs draftId and accept:true. create accepts filled documents or a recipe, validates all themes, refuses replacement and removes a brand whose build fails. Full schema: oods://schemas/brand_create.input.json.

brand_id.description: The id the brand will have. Actions: create (required), draft (required). See full schema for details.

documents.description: The filled template: one plain design-token document per theme, brand-relative (surface.canvas, not color.brand.<id>.surface.canvas), each slot {"$type": "color", "$value": "<CSS colour>"}. Actions: create.

recipe.description: A brand recipe in place of documents: the brand it gives is checked, and for create written, like filled documents. Actions: create.

modes.description: modes. Fields: base, dark. See full schema.

name: brand_create
title: Create Brand
